nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: Why must tire inflation pressure be raised with an increasing load?
nodes.answer: Tire inflation pressure must be raised to maintain acceptable deformations, avoid damage to the tire, and ensure safety.

nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: Why is it important to restore recommended tire inflation pressure when using firmer surfaces?
nodes.answer: Restoring the recommended tire inflation pressure is important when using firmer surfaces to maintain optimal tire performance and safety, ensuring proper load support and handling.
